shinezaya.name: Shinezaya
shinezaya.bio: Hi, I'm Shinezaya. I believe the digital world is not just code, pixels, and buttons — it's the story between people and technology. Making that story clearer and more delightful is both my work and my passion.
shinezaya.fullBio: For the past 3+ years as a UI/UX designer, I've been crafting meaningful experiences that are memorable and easy to understand. To me, great design is 'invisible'—it quietly guides users through their journey while solving real problems. Every project brings a new challenge, a new insight, and a new opportunity. When I'm not designing, I love exploring trends, trying new tools, or sharing learnings with the design community.

services.title: Services
services.intro: We help startups and teams design, build, and ship polished products end to end — full-stack development for iOS, Android, and web, plus branding, marketing content, AI-enhanced video, and drone production.

ios.title: iOS App Development
ios.desc: Swift/SwiftUI/UIKit, App Store operations, Go API integration, Firebase, offline-first sync. Clean architecture, testing, and performance optimization.

web.title: Frontend Engineering
web.desc: Next.js/React/Vue/Nuxt, multilingual support, SEO 95+, Go + Postgres APIs. Responsive, accessible, and performant web applications.

ux.title: Product Design & UX
ux.desc: Figma design systems, user flows, prototyping, handoff perfection. We ensure pixel-perfect implementation and exceptional user experience.

android.title: Android App Development
android.desc: Native Android apps with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, Google Play releases, and the same Go/Firebase backends as our iOS work — one team for both platforms.

backend.title: Backend & System Design
backend.desc: Go APIs, PostgreSQL, Redis caching, MinIO object storage, Grafana monitoring. Production-grade infrastructure — real-time chat, notifications, and auth (Google & Apple sign-in) included.

content.title: Marketing, Branding & Video
content.desc: Brand identity and marketing content, AI-enhanced and generated videos, professional video editing, and DJI Mini 3 drone shots. We shoot, edit, and deliver ready-to-post visuals for your brand.

pricing.title: From ₮500,000
pricing.desc: Projects start at ₮500,000 and scale with features and scope. Tell us what you need and we'll come back with a clear, itemized quote — no surprises.
